items.title: Alton Purnell Interview, 1968-03-03
items.q: Oh, I could just talk to Louis... Just talk with him, and I enjoy myself. He's a wonderful guy to talk with, man, you know.

ctx.x: I haven't seen him in years. I had him on interviews some years ago when he had Tee Garden with him and Barrett Deems and a lot of the other boys were with him at the time. They were playing over in San Francisco, and we had him on the air, and he was a kick to talk to.
Oh, I could just talk to Louis, but I don't have to hear him play. Just talk with him, and I enjoy myself. He's a wonderful guy to talk with, man, you know.
Alton, do you find that Louis sings about the way he plays?
